top_choice_rationale: P005 rewards a validated design chain (organic structure-directing agent to framework topology to active-site placement to catalytic function) that underlies Cu-SSZ-13 NOx abatement, methanol-to-olefins and hydrocracking, has been confirmed independently for decades, and carries no maturity question; the Corma, Davis, Zones attribution is subjective but defensible. P001 is a close second on explicit mechanism and clean three-name credit but is pre-approval; I place mature, well-attributed work above it.
recusal_note: Potential field proximity: my research on zeolites and porous crystalline materials is close to B051 (P005), which I support, and I know Yu and Tsapatsis's field, though neither is a proposed laureate; Stockholm University colleague of Peter Brzezinski, which bears on no candidate.
